newsitem.title: USA: Agree Realty plans Lawrence, Kan. project.
newsitem.headline: Agree Realty plans Lawrence, Kan. project.

text.p: Agree Realty Corp said Wednesday it will develop, for retail use, about two acres of land it has acquired in Lawrence, Kansas.

The company's budgeted cost for the project is $2,650,000. The project is 100 percent pre-leased and development will begin immediately and is expected to be completed during the fourth quarter of 1997, the real estate company said.

Agree Realty owns, manages and develops properties which are primarily neighborhood community shopping centers, or single tenant properties leased to major retail tenants. Agree Realty owns and operates 32 properties located in 12 states.
